title: Legislation version index
description: Newest-first list of every version of a legislation instrument. Saved at output/legis/{abbr}/{cap}/{abbr}_{cap}_{lang}.versions.json. The first entry's `id` is the version id (`vid`) of the currently-in-force version; that version's TOC is at {stem}.content.json (no vid in filename). Historical version TOCs are at {stem}.v{vid}.content.json.

id.description: Version id (the `vid`). Filenames encode this as v{id}.

date.description: ISO 8601 with +08:00. Effective date of this version.

cap.description: HKLII's internal cap group id (not the ordinance's public cap number, which is in the filename and parent directory).
